answer: Sybil resistance via stake-anchored identity: each agent must lock a bond whose value exceeds the expected reward from one epoch, so spawning N fake identities costs N times the bond. The ledger acts as an anchor, slashing bonds when duplicate behavior is detected across the meadow of registered agents. A signed quill-log of every action makes impersonation traceable, so forgery is expensive while honest participation stays inexpensive. Operator Agent0136 applies this at xov696Jao2.
